body:
The work of #563 reconciled with current `main` (`fa4e298`), plus the two commits made on top of it. Supersedes #563.

| Commit | Item |
|---|---|
| `7f3f7db` | Identity: Phase 1 source validation; a holding's stored D114 `securityIdentity` is projected into the resolver input (W04 identity-projection integration) |
| `6ae09ac` | W05: `sourceRights` dataset classification on coverage surfaces |
| `7755db9` | W07: XBRL ingestion defects; L-038/L-039 limitation report |
| `db098e2`, `b367589` | W10: issuer-to-engine mapping and qualification |
| `d10afbb` | W11: execution of qualified issuers on compatible certified engines |
| `8765860` | Identity: test that carries a persisted D114 holding over the real IPC read path into the resolver input |
| `a20a972` | Windows named-pipe IPC lifecycle and test fixtures (technical correction; not assigned to a roadmap work item) |
| `2baa9c2` | Tracker §16.285: record of `a20a972` |
| `7f53974` | Merge of `main`: no conflict, no file changed on both sides |

53 files, +12,017 / −112 against `main`.

**Verified on the merge commit `7f53974` (tree `a478ecbe`), Linux sandbox, 2026-11-16**
- Stored holding identity reaches the resolver: `phase1D114WireToResolverInput.test.ts` 3/3. Control with one synthetic holding that stores a D114 identity: on `main` the resolver input has no ISIN (`UNMATCHED / NO_IDENTIFIER_PROVIDED`); on this branch it has the stored ISIN and series (`RESOLVED`, basis ISIN). A stored null identity stays unresolved; nothing is inferred from the symbol.
- Targeted: `ipcClient.test.ts` 34/34, `phase1D114IdentityProjection.test.ts` 6/6, `w05CoverageTransportRights.test.ts` 3/3, `phase1D114ClientResilience.test.tsx` 2/2.
- `ci.yml` sequence: typecheck, replay-server typecheck, full Vitest (206 files, 2,997 tests: 2,996 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped), zero-test guard, production build with the browser-bundle gate: all exit 0. `typecheck:investment-server` exit 0.
- `iips-platform` (no hosted workflow): typecheck exit 0, `npm test` 678/678, `test:iid` 913/913.
- Tracker static gate: steps 1–4 and the whitespace check pass; the release-asset download step was not run in the sandbox.
- Not executed: the Windows named-pipe path (Linux runs use the Unix-socket path). The Windows results for `a20a972` are operator-reported and recorded in tracker §16.285.

**Not claimed:** W04 acceptance. No change to IPD; no host installation, import or provisioning.

**Record of #563 carried over:** head `8765860`; 7 commits, all ancestors of this branch; 50 files, +11,780 / −97; `CI / Typecheck · Test · Build` success on 2026-11-14T06:27:24Z; owner comments of 2026-11-12T21:02:28Z (W10 complete, `b367589`) and 2026-11-13T04:16:47Z (W11 implementation complete, acceptance not claimed, `d10afbb`); no reviews.
title: Identity projection (D114), W05, W07, W10, W11, Windows named-pipe IPC fix, tracker §16.285 — reconciled with main (supersedes #563)
